subject_line: Cache checked and mapped regex patterns
s1_reason: match()/search() function extensions now cache the I-Regexp check, map_re rewrite and compiled pattern in an LRU (function_extensions/match.py, search.py)
s2_reason: one call per node the filter visits
s3_reason: grammar's test-expr functions match(...)/search(...) with an I-Regexp string literal inside <filter_selector>; called once per candidate node during compiled.findall(doc), which is timed. Caveat: the frozen pyjsonpath env installs neither regex nor iregexp-check, so before the change only re.fullmatch's own cache lookup is replaced; the large win (uncached iregexp check) needs iregexp-check installed
confounds: 2.0.0 is a rewrite: new lexer/parser and segment/selector model, syntax changes (bracket names, float literals, slice leading zeros, dot whitespace), keys/singular-query selectors, max_recursion_depth. Any delta is mostly the rewrite, not this commit
notes: via: keyword (cache); deduplicated with merge 863d47d; correctness: 2.0.0 changes results/acceptance for some inputs vs 1.3.2 (equivalence must be re-checked per input)
